question: How is Maheshvari of twenty syllables invoked to protect the navel always?
premises: The navel is the body part to be protected.
Maheshvari is described as having twenty syllables.
inference: The twenty-syllable Maheshvari is invoked to always protect the navel.
plain_english: May Maheshvari of the twenty-syllable mantra always protect my navel.
